' ============================================================================
' DEFENDER - ZX Spectrum Next Edition (Layer 2 + 16x16 256-Colour Sprites)
' ============================================================================
' NTC BASIC build. Changes from the original to make it compile and run under NTC are marked
' "NTC:". The terrain, scanner and radar are drawn on Layer 2 (L2.cls), the words on the
' tilemap (Board.cls), the sound on the AY (Sfx.cls). The sprite code is the original's.
Option Explicit
Option Turbo

' ZX Spectrum Next Hardware Ports
Const PORT_NEXTREG_SEL As Integer = &H243B
Const PORT_NEXTREG_DAT As Integer = &H253B
Const PORT_SPRITE_SLOT As Integer = &H303B
Const PORT_SPRITE_ATTR As Integer = &H57
Const PORT_SPRITE_PAT  As Integer = &H5B

' World & Layer 2 Screen Constants (Layer 2 = 256x192, Sprites offset +32,+32)
Const WORLD_W As Integer = 1024
Const WORLD_MASK As Integer = 1023
Const SCR_W As Integer = 256
Const SCR_H As Integer = 192
Const SPR_X_OFF As Integer = 32
Const SPR_Y_OFF As Integer = 32
Const PLAY_TOP As Integer = 40
Const PLAY_BOT As Integer = 172

' Sprite Pattern Indices in DEFENDER.SPR
Const PAT_PLAYER As Integer = 0
Const PAT_LANDER As Integer = 1
Const PAT_MUTANT As Integer = 2
Const PAT_HUMAN  As Integer = 3
Const PAT_BOLT   As Integer = 4

' Hardware Sprite Slot Allocations
' Slot 0: Player
' Slots 1..4: Player Lasers
' Slots 5..12: Humanoids (8)
' Slots 13..22: Enemies (10)
' Slots 23..28: Enemy Shots (6)
Const SLOT_PLAYER As Integer = 0
Const SLOT_LASER0 As Integer = 1
Const SLOT_HUMAN0 As Integer = 5
Const SLOT_ENEMY0 As Integer = 13
Const SLOT_SHOT0  As Integer = 23

' Entity Counts
Const MAX_LASERS As Integer = 4
Const MAX_HUMANS As Integer = 8
Const MAX_ENEMIES As Integer = 10
Const MAX_SHOTS As Integer = 6

' States
Const ST_DEAD As Integer = 0
Const ST_WANDER As Integer = 1
Const ST_DESCEND As Integer = 2
Const ST_ABDUCT As Integer = 3
Const ST_MUTANT As Integer = 4

Const H_DEAD As Integer = 0
Const H_GROUND As Integer = 1
Const H_GRABBED As Integer = 2
Const H_FALLING As Integer = 3
Const H_CARRIED As Integer = 4

' Player State
Dim px As Integer, py As Integer
Dim pvx As Integer, pvy As Integer
Dim pdir As Integer
Dim old_prx As Integer, old_pry As Integer

Dim score As Long          ' NTC: Long (an Integer stops at 32767)
Dim lives As Integer
Dim bombs As Integer
Dim wave As Integer
Dim game_over As Boolean
Dim planet_dead As Boolean
Dim fire_cd As Integer
Dim bomb_cd As Integer
Dim hyper_cd As Integer
Dim flash_bg As Integer

' Lasers
Dim lx(MAX_LASERS) As Integer
Dim ly(MAX_LASERS) As Integer
Dim lvx(MAX_LASERS) As Integer
Dim llife(MAX_LASERS) As Integer

' Humanoids
Dim hx(MAX_HUMANS) As Integer
Dim hy(MAX_HUMANS) As Integer
Dim hstate(MAX_HUMANS) As Integer
Dim hcarrier(MAX_HUMANS) As Integer
Dim old_hrx(MAX_HUMANS) As Integer
Dim humans_alive As Integer

' Enemies
Dim ex(MAX_ENEMIES) As Integer
Dim ey(MAX_ENEMIES) As Integer
Dim evx(MAX_ENEMIES) As Integer
Dim evy(MAX_ENEMIES) As Integer
Dim estate(MAX_ENEMIES) As Integer
Dim etarget(MAX_ENEMIES) As Integer
Dim old_erx(MAX_ENEMIES) As Integer
Dim old_ery(MAX_ENEMIES) As Integer
Dim enemies_alive As Integer
Dim spawn_timer As Integer
Dim enemies_to_spawn As Integer

' Enemy Projectiles
Dim sx(MAX_SHOTS) As Integer
Dim sy(MAX_SHOTS) As Integer
Dim svx(MAX_SHOTS) As Integer
Dim svy(MAX_SHOTS) As Integer
Dim slife(MAX_SHOTS) As Integer

' Terrain Streaming State (8 slices across 256px screen)
Dim ter_step As Integer
Dim old_ty0(8) As Integer
Dim old_ty1(8) As Integer

' NTC: the CPC-style graphics the original used (Plot / Draw with a pen colour, bottom-up y),
' done here on Layer 2: the last point plotted, and the pen colours as Layer 2 colours
Dim gx As Integer, gy As Integer, penc(15) As Integer, txtPen As Integer, atx As Integer, aty As Integer
Dim i As Integer, j As Integer, cam_x As Integer, psx As Integer, lsx As Integer
Dim hsx As Integer, hrx As Integer, t_ground As Integer
Dim esx As Integer, erx As Integer, ery As Integer, epat As Integer, ecol As Integer
Dim th As Integer, dx_h As Integer, l_idx As Integer, hit As Boolean, s_idx As Integer, ssx As Integer
Dim tx0 As Integer, tx1 As Integer, ty0 As Integer, ty1 As Integer
Dim sprbuf(1791) As Byte
Dim ycol(255) As Integer, tcam As Integer, terOn As Integer, terDead As Boolean

' ============================================================================
' ZX SPECTRUM NEXT HARDWARE REGISTER & SPRITE HELPERS
' ============================================================================

Sub WriteNextReg(ByVal reg As Integer, ByVal val As Integer)
    Out PORT_NEXTREG_SEL, reg
    Out PORT_NEXTREG_DAT, val
End Sub

' Loads DEFENDER.SPR (512B 9-bit palette + 5x 256B 16x16 8-bit sprites)
Sub LoadSpriteTilemap(ByVal filename As String)
    Dim b0 As Integer
    Dim p As Integer, x As Integer, y As Integer, dx As Integer, dy As Integer

    ' Enable Sprites Visible (bit 0) + Sprites Over Border (bit 1), SUL order
    ' NTC: SUL (&H08), not SLU: the words are on the tilemap, which has to be over Layer 2
    WriteNextReg(&H15, &H0B)
    ' Sprite transparency index = 0
    WriteNextReg(&H4B, &H00)

    ' Select Sprite First Palette for writing (bits 6..4 = 010 -> &H20)
    WriteNextReg(&H43, &H20)
    WriteNextReg(&H40, 0)

    ' NTC: no Open / Get: FileSystem.Load reads the whole file (on platforms with files; the
    ' Next build has none yet, so the patterns below are made instead)
    If FileSystem.Load(filename, VarPtr(sprbuf), 1792) = 1792 Then
        ' 1. Upload 256-colour 9-bit palette (512 bytes -> NextReg &H44)
        For i = 0 To 255
            WriteNextReg(&H44, sprbuf(i * 2))
            WriteNextReg(&H44, sprbuf(i * 2 + 1))
        Next i

        ' 2. Upload 5 x 16x16 8-bit sprite patterns (1280 bytes -> Port &H5B)
        Out PORT_SPRITE_SLOT, 0
        For i = 512 To 1791
            Out PORT_SPRITE_PAT, sprbuf(i)
        Next i
    Else
        ' Fallback procedural 9-bit palette + 16x16 patterns if file not attached
        WriteNextReg(&H44, 0) : WriteNextReg(&H44, 0)     ' 0: Transparent
        WriteNextReg(&H44, &HFF) : WriteNextReg(&H44, 1)  ' 1: White
        WriteNextReg(&H44, &HFC) : WriteNextReg(&H44, 0)  ' 2: Yellow
        WriteNextReg(&H44, &HF0) : WriteNextReg(&H44, 0)  ' 3: Orange
        WriteNextReg(&H44, &HE0) : WriteNextReg(&H44, 0)  ' 4: Red
        WriteNextReg(&H44, &HE2) : WriteNextReg(&H44, 1)  ' 5: Magenta
        WriteNextReg(&H44, &H1C) : WriteNextReg(&H44, 0)  ' 6: Green
        WriteNextReg(&H44, &H17) : WriteNextReg(&H44, 1)  ' 7: Cyan
        For i = 8 To 255
            WriteNextReg(&H44, i)
            WriteNextReg(&H44, 0)
        Next i

        Out PORT_SPRITE_SLOT, 0
        For p = 0 To 4
            For y = 0 To 15
                For x = 0 To 15
                    b0 = 0
                    dx = Abs(x - 7) : dy = Abs(y - 7)
                    If p = PAT_PLAYER Then
                        If y >= 5 And y <= 10 And x <= 14 And dy <= (15 - x) \ 2 Then b0 = 7
                        If y = 7 And x >= 10 Then b0 = 1
                        If x < 3 And dy <= 1 Then b0 = 3
                    ElseIf p = PAT_LANDER Then
                        If dx + dy <= 6 Then b0 = 6
                        If dy = 1 And (x = 5 Or x = 10) Then b0 = 1
                    ElseIf p = PAT_MUTANT Then
                        If dx = dy Or (dx <= 4 And dy <= 4) Then b0 = 4
                        If dx <= 2 And dy <= 2 Then b0 = 2
                    ElseIf p = PAT_HUMAN Then
                        If dx <= 1 And y >= 3 And y <= 5 Then b0 = 1
                        If dx <= 2 And y >= 6 And y <= 12 Then b0 = 5
                    ElseIf p = PAT_BOLT Then
                        If y >= 7 And y <= 8 And x >= 2 And x <= 13 Then b0 = 2
                    End If
                    Out PORT_SPRITE_PAT, b0
                Next x
            Next y
        Next p
    End If
End Sub

' Updates a hardware sprite slot (px_scr in 0..255 Layer 2 coords, py_scr in 0..191)
Sub SetHardwareSprite(ByVal slot As Integer, ByVal px_scr As Integer, ByVal py_scr As Integer, ByVal pat As Integer, ByVal hflip As Boolean, ByVal visible As Boolean)
    Dim sx As Integer, sy As Integer, attr2 As Integer
    Out PORT_SPRITE_SLOT, slot
    If Not visible Then
        Out PORT_SPRITE_ATTR, 0
        Out PORT_SPRITE_ATTR, 0
        Out PORT_SPRITE_ATTR, 0
        Out PORT_SPRITE_ATTR, 0
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' Convert Layer 2 (256x192, bottom-left Y in NTC) to Next Sprite Coords (+32 border, top-down Y)
    sx = px_scr + SPR_X_OFF - 8
    sy = (191 - py_scr) + SPR_Y_OFF - 8

    attr2 = (sx \ 256) And 1          ' NTC: no >>
    If hflip Then attr2 = attr2 Or 8

    Out PORT_SPRITE_ATTR, sx And 255
    Out PORT_SPRITE_ATTR, sy And 255
    Out PORT_SPRITE_ATTR, attr2
    ' Bit 7 = Visible (128), Bit 6 = 5-byte extended attribute (64)
    Out PORT_SPRITE_ATTR, 192 Or (pat And 63)
    ' 5th attribute byte = 0 (8-bit 256-colour pattern, no scaling)
    Out PORT_SPRITE_ATTR, 0
End Sub

Sub HideAllSprites()
    Dim s As Integer
    Out PORT_SPRITE_SLOT, 0
    For s = 0 To 63
        Out PORT_SPRITE_ATTR, 0
        Out PORT_SPRITE_ATTR, 0
        Out PORT_SPRITE_ATTR, 0
        Out PORT_SPRITE_ATTR, 0
    Next s
End Sub

' ============================================================================
' COORDINATE & TERRAIN HELPERS
' ============================================================================

Function GetTerrainY(ByVal wx As Integer) As Integer
    Dim p As Integer, h As Integer
    p = (wx \ 4) And 63
    If p < 16 Then
        h = 10 + p
    ElseIf p < 32 Then
        h = 26 - (p - 16)
    ElseIf p < 40 Then
        h = 10 + (p - 32) * 2
    ElseIf p < 48 Then
        h = 26 - (p - 40) * 2
    Else
        h = 10
    End If
    If planet_dead Then h = 6
    GetTerrainY = h          ' NTC: assign to the name (no Return value)
End Function

Function WorldToScreenX(ByVal wx As Integer, ByVal cx As Integer) As Integer
    Dim d As Integer
    d = (wx - cx) And WORLD_MASK
    If d >= 512 Then d = d - 1024
    WorldToScreenX = d
End Function

Function WorldToRadarX(ByVal wx As Integer) As Integer
    Dim rel As Integer
    rel = (wx - px + 512) And WORLD_MASK
    WorldToRadarX = 64 + (rel \ 8)
End Function

Sub UpdateHUD()
    Pen 15
    At 1, 1
    PrintS "SC:" & Str$(score) & " "
    Pen 14
    At 12, 1
    PrintS "L:" & Str$(lives) & " B:" & Str$(bombs) & " "
    Pen 11
    At 26, 1
    PrintS "W:" & Str$(wave) & " "
End Sub

Sub DrawStaticFrame()
    ClsAll
    ' Scanner divider and radar box (x = 62..193, y = 152..183 in bottom-up Layer 2 coords)
    Plot 0, 150, 9
    Draw 255, 150, 9
    Plot 62, 152, 12
    Draw 193, 152, 12
    Draw 193, 182, 12
    Draw 62, 182, 12
    Draw 62, 152, 12
    UpdateHUD()
End Sub

' ============================================================================
' WAVE & ENTITY MANAGEMENT
' ============================================================================

Sub InitWave()
    Dim i As Integer
    HideAllSprites()
    DrawStaticFrame()

    px = 512
    py = 96
    pvx = 0
    pvy = 0
    pdir = 1
    old_prx = 128
    old_pry = 165

    For i = 0 To MAX_LASERS - 1
        llife(i) = 0
    Next i

    For i = 0 To MAX_SHOTS - 1
        slife(i) = 0
    Next i

    If wave = 1 Then
        planet_dead = False
        humans_alive = MAX_HUMANS
        For i = 0 To MAX_HUMANS - 1
            hx(i) = (i * 128 + 48) And WORLD_MASK
            hy(i) = GetTerrainY(hx(i)) + 6
            hstate(i) = H_GROUND
            hcarrier(i) = -1
            old_hrx(i) = 0
        Next i
    Else
        For i = 0 To MAX_HUMANS - 1
            old_hrx(i) = 0
            If hstate(i) <> H_DEAD Then
                hstate(i) = H_GROUND
                hcarrier(i) = -1
                hy(i) = GetTerrainY(hx(i)) + 6
            End If
        Next i
    End If

    For i = 0 To MAX_ENEMIES - 1
        estate(i) = ST_DEAD
        old_erx(i) = 0
    Next i

    enemies_to_spawn = 6 + wave * 2
    If enemies_to_spawn > MAX_ENEMIES Then enemies_to_spawn = MAX_ENEMIES
    enemies_alive = 0
    spawn_timer = 10

    For i = 0 To 4
        SpawnEnemy()
    Next i

    For i = 0 To 7
        old_ty0(i) = -1
    Next i
    ter_step = 0
    terOn = 0          ' NTC: (nothing of the terrain on the screen after ClsAll)
    UpdateHUD()
End Sub

Sub SpawnEnemy()
    Dim i As Integer
    If enemies_to_spawn <= 0 Then Exit Sub
    For i = 0 To MAX_ENEMIES - 1
        If estate(i) = ST_DEAD Then
            ex(i) = (px + 250 + Rnd(500)) And WORLD_MASK
            ey(i) = 130 + Rnd(15)
            If Rnd(2) = 0 Then evx(i) = 2 Else evx(i) = -2
            evy(i) = -1
            If planet_dead Then
                estate(i) = ST_MUTANT
            Else
                estate(i) = ST_WANDER
            End If
            etarget(i) = -1
            old_erx(i) = 0
            enemies_alive = enemies_alive + 1
            enemies_to_spawn = enemies_to_spawn - 1
            Exit Sub
        End If
    Next i
End Sub

Sub FireLaser()
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To MAX_LASERS - 1
        If llife(i) = 0 Then
            lx(i) = (px + pdir * 12) And WORLD_MASK
            ly(i) = py
            lvx(i) = pdir * 20 + pvx
            llife(i) = 12
            Sound 1, 110, 4, 12
            Exit Sub
        End If
    Next i
End Sub

Sub KillEnemy(ByVal idx As Integer)
    Dim h As Integer
    SetHardwareSprite(SLOT_ENEMY0 + idx, 0, 0, 0, False, False)
    If old_erx(idx) > 0 Then
        Plot old_erx(idx), old_ery(idx), 0
        old_erx(idx) = 0
    End If

    h = etarget(idx)
    If h >= 0 And h < MAX_HUMANS Then
        If hstate(h) = H_GRABBED And hcarrier(h) = idx Then
            hstate(h) = H_FALLING
            hcarrier(h) = -1
        End If
    End If

    estate(idx) = ST_DEAD
    enemies_alive = enemies_alive - 1
    Sound 2, 260, 6, 14
End Sub

Sub TriggerSmartBomb(ByVal cx As Integer)
    Dim i As Integer, sx_pos As Integer
    If bombs <= 0 Then Exit Sub
    bombs = bombs - 1
    bomb_cd = 20
    Sound 1, 380, 15, 15
    Border 7
    flash_bg = 4

    For i = 0 To MAX_ENEMIES - 1
        If estate(i) <> ST_DEAD Then
            sx_pos = WorldToScreenX(ex(i), cx)
            If sx_pos >= -16 And sx_pos <= 272 Then
                KillEnemy(i)
                score = score + 15
            End If
        End If
    Next i
    UpdateHUD()
End Sub

Sub LoseLife()
    Dim i As Integer
    Sound 1, 750, 25, 15
    Border 2
    For i = 1 To 25
        Vsync
    Next i
    Border 0

    lives = lives - 1
    If lives <= 0 Then
        HideAllSprites()
        game_over = True
    Else
        For i = 0 To MAX_HUMANS - 1
            If hstate(i) = H_CARRIED Then
                hstate(i) = H_FALLING
            End If
        Next i
        InitWave()
    End If
End Sub

' ============================================================================
' MAIN PROGRAM ENTRY
' ============================================================================

' NTC: the screen: the tilemap for the words (over), Layer 2 for the drawing (under), the AY
Tiles.Init
Spr.Init
GfxData.Load
Sfx.Init
Board.Init
L2.Init
Nx.Layers Nx.OrderSUL
SetPens
Border 0
Paper 0
Pen 15
ClsAll
' Load replaceable 16x16 9-bit palette sprite sheet
LoadSpriteTilemap("DEFENDER.SPR")

Do
    HideAllSprites()
    ClsAll
    Pen 14
    At 8, 4
    PrintS "D E F E N D E R"
    Pen 11
    At 4, 6
    PrintS "ZX SPECTRUM NEXT EDITION"
    Pen 15
    At 4, 10
    PrintS "Q / A or UP/DN : ALTITUDE"
    At 4, 12
    PrintS "O / P or LT/RT : THRUST"
    At 4, 14
    PrintS "SPACE / FIRE 1 : LASER"
    At 4, 16
    PrintS "B / M / FIRE 2 : SMART BOMB"
    At 4, 18
    PrintS "H              : HYPERSPACE"
    Pen 10
    At 5, 22
    PrintS "PRESS SPACE OR FIRE"

    ' Display preview sprites on the title screen
    ' NTC: y 32 (was 52, which sat on the HYPERSPACE line)
    SetHardwareSprite(0, 70, 32, PAT_PLAYER, False, True)
    SetHardwareSprite(1, 110, 32, PAT_LANDER, False, True)
    SetHardwareSprite(2, 150, 32, PAT_MUTANT, False, True)
    SetHardwareSprite(3, 190, 32, PAT_HUMAN, False, True)

    Do
        Vsync
    Loop Until Key(40) Or (Joy(0) And 16) <> 0

    score = 0
    lives = 3
    bombs = 3
    wave = 1
    game_over = False
    InitWave()

    Do While Not game_over
        Vsync
        If flash_bg > 0 Then
            flash_bg = flash_bg - 1
            If flash_bg = 0 Then Border 0
        End If

        ' --------------------------------------------------------------------
        ' 1. ZX SPECTRUM NEXT INPUT (KEYBOARD + KEMPSTON JOYSTICK)
        ' --------------------------------------------------------------------
        j = Joy(0)

        ' Up: Q (3) or Joy Up (8) | Down: A (2) or Joy Down (4)
        If Key(3) Or (j And 8) <> 0 Then
            pvy = 3
        ElseIf Key(2) Or (j And 4) <> 0 Then
            pvy = -3
        Else
            pvy = 0
        End If

        ' Left: O (33) or Joy Left (2) | Right: P (32) or Joy Right (1)
        If Key(33) Or (j And 2) <> 0 Then
            pdir = -1
            If pvx > -12 Then pvx = pvx - 1
        ElseIf Key(32) Or (j And 1) <> 0 Then
            pdir = 1
            If pvx < 12 Then pvx = pvx + 1
        Else
            If pvx > 0 Then pvx = pvx - 1
            If pvx < 0 Then pvx = pvx + 1
        End If

        px = (px + pvx) And WORLD_MASK
        py = py + pvy
        If py < PLAY_TOP Then py = PLAY_TOP
        If py > PLAY_BOT - 12 Then py = PLAY_BOT - 12

        psx = 128 - pdir * 40
        cam_x = (px - psx) And WORLD_MASK

        ' Fire Laser: Space (40), Z (9), or Joy Fire 1 (16)
        If fire_cd > 0 Then fire_cd = fire_cd - 1
        If (Key(40) Or Key(9) Or (j And 16) <> 0) And fire_cd = 0 Then
            FireLaser()
            fire_cd = 4
        End If

        ' Smart Bomb: B (36), M (34), or Joy Fire 2 (32)
        If bomb_cd > 0 Then bomb_cd = bomb_cd - 1
        If (Key(36) Or Key(34) Or (j And 32) <> 0) And bomb_cd = 0 Then
            TriggerSmartBomb(cam_x)
        End If

        ' Hyperspace: H (38)
        If hyper_cd > 0 Then hyper_cd = hyper_cd - 1
        If Key(38) And hyper_cd = 0 Then
            Plot old_prx, old_pry, 0
            px = Rnd(WORLD_W)
            py = 50 + Rnd(85)
            pvx = 0
            hyper_cd = 30
            Sound 1, 550, 8, 13
        End If

        ' --------------------------------------------------------------------
        ' 2. UPDATE PLAYER HARDWARE SPRITE & RADAR PIP
        ' --------------------------------------------------------------------
        SetHardwareSprite(SLOT_PLAYER, psx, py, PAT_PLAYER, (pdir < 0), True)

        Plot old_prx, old_pry, 0
        old_prx = 128
        old_pry = 154 + (py \ 7)
        Plot old_prx, old_pry, 15

        ' --------------------------------------------------------------------
        ' 3. UPDATE LASER HARDWARE SPRITES
        ' --------------------------------------------------------------------
        For i = 0 To MAX_LASERS - 1
            If llife(i) > 0 Then
                lx(i) = (lx(i) + lvx(i)) And WORLD_MASK
                llife(i) = llife(i) - 1
                lsx = WorldToScreenX(lx(i), cam_x)
                If llife(i) > 0 And lsx >= 0 And lsx <= 255 Then
                    SetHardwareSprite(SLOT_LASER0 + i, lsx, ly(i), PAT_BOLT, (lvx(i) < 0), True)
                Else
                    llife(i) = 0
                    SetHardwareSprite(SLOT_LASER0 + i, 0, 0, 0, False, False)
                End If
            Else
                SetHardwareSprite(SLOT_LASER0 + i, 0, 0, 0, False, False)
            End If
        Next i

        ' --------------------------------------------------------------------
        ' 4. UPDATE HUMANOID HARDWARE SPRITES & RADAR PIPS
        ' --------------------------------------------------------------------
        For i = 0 To MAX_HUMANS - 1
            If old_hrx(i) > 0 Then
                Plot old_hrx(i), 154, 0
                old_hrx(i) = 0
            End If

            If hstate(i) <> H_DEAD Then
                If hstate(i) = H_CARRIED Then
                    hx(i) = px
                    hy(i) = py - 10
                    t_ground = GetTerrainY(hx(i)) + 6
                    ' (the ship can't fly below PLAY_TOP, so flying as low as it goes puts the human down)
                    If hy(i) <= t_ground Or py <= PLAY_TOP Then
                        hy(i) = t_ground
                        hstate(i) = H_GROUND
                        score = score + 50
                        Sound 1, 90, 8, 14
                        UpdateHUD()
                    End If
                ElseIf hstate(i) = H_FALLING Then
                    hy(i) = hy(i) - 1
                    If Abs(WorldToScreenX(hx(i), cam_x) - psx) < 12 And Abs(hy(i) - py) < 12 Then
                        hstate(i) = H_CARRIED
                        score = score + 50
                        Sound 1, 110, 6, 14
                        UpdateHUD()
                    Else
                        t_ground = GetTerrainY(hx(i)) + 6
                        If hy(i) <= t_ground Then
                            hy(i) = t_ground
                            hstate(i) = H_GROUND
                            score = score + 25
                            UpdateHUD()
                        End If
                    End If
                End If

                hsx = WorldToScreenX(hx(i), cam_x)
                If hsx >= -8 And hsx <= 263 Then
                    SetHardwareSprite(SLOT_HUMAN0 + i, hsx, hy(i), PAT_HUMAN, False, True)
                Else
                    SetHardwareSprite(SLOT_HUMAN0 + i, 0, 0, 0, False, False)
                End If

                hrx = WorldToRadarX(hx(i))
                Plot hrx, 154, 13
                old_hrx(i) = hrx
            Else
                SetHardwareSprite(SLOT_HUMAN0 + i, 0, 0, 0, False, False)
            End If
        Next i

        ' --------------------------------------------------------------------
        ' 5. UPDATE ENEMY HARDWARE SPRITES & AI
        ' --------------------------------------------------------------------
        If spawn_timer > 0 Then
            spawn_timer = spawn_timer - 1
        ElseIf enemies_to_spawn > 0 And enemies_alive < 7 Then
            SpawnEnemy()
            spawn_timer = 40
        End If


        For i = 0 To MAX_ENEMIES - 1
            If old_erx(i) > 0 Then
                Plot old_erx(i), old_ery(i), 0
                old_erx(i) = 0
            End If

            If estate(i) <> ST_DEAD Then
                If estate(i) = ST_WANDER Then
                    ex(i) = (ex(i) + evx(i)) And WORLD_MASK
                    ey(i) = ey(i) + evy(i)
                    If ey(i) < 65 Then evy(i) = 1
                    If ey(i) > 138 Then evy(i) = -1

                    If Rnd(20) = 0 And humans_alive > 0 Then
                        th = Rnd(MAX_HUMANS)
                        If hstate(th) = H_GROUND Then
                            etarget(i) = th
                            estate(i) = ST_DESCEND
                        End If
                    End If

                ElseIf estate(i) = ST_DESCEND Then
                    th = etarget(i)
                    If th < 0 Or hstate(th) <> H_GROUND Then
                        estate(i) = ST_WANDER
                    Else
                        dx_h = WorldToScreenX(hx(th), ex(i))
                        If dx_h > 2 Then
                            ex(i) = (ex(i) + 2) And WORLD_MASK
                        ElseIf dx_h < -2 Then
                            ex(i) = (ex(i) - 2) And WORLD_MASK
                        Else
                            If ey(i) > hy(th) + 8 Then
                                ey(i) = ey(i) - 2
                            Else
                                hstate(th) = H_GRABBED
                                hcarrier(th) = i
                                estate(i) = ST_ABDUCT
                                Sound 2, 480, 5, 12
                            End If
                        End If
                    End If

                ElseIf estate(i) = ST_ABDUCT Then
                    th = etarget(i)
                    If th < 0 Or hstate(th) <> H_GRABBED Then
                        estate(i) = ST_WANDER
                    Else
                        ey(i) = ey(i) + 1
                        hx(th) = ex(i)
                        hy(th) = ey(i) - 10
                        If ey(i) >= 142 Then
                            hstate(th) = H_DEAD
                            humans_alive = humans_alive - 1
                            estate(i) = ST_MUTANT
                            Sound 1, 70, 15, 15
                            If humans_alive <= 0 And Not planet_dead Then
                                planet_dead = True
                                Border 2
                                flash_bg = 6
                            End If
                        End If
                    End If

                ElseIf estate(i) = ST_MUTANT Then
                    dx_h = WorldToScreenX(px, ex(i))
                    If dx_h > 0 Then
                        ex(i) = (ex(i) + 3) And WORLD_MASK
                    Else
                        ex(i) = (ex(i) - 3) And WORLD_MASK
                    End If
                    If ey(i) < py Then
                        ey(i) = ey(i) + 2
                    ElseIf ey(i) > py Then
                        ey(i) = ey(i) - 2
                    End If
                End If

                ' Laser Collision Check
                hit = False
                esx = WorldToScreenX(ex(i), cam_x)
                For l_idx = 0 To MAX_LASERS - 1
                    If llife(l_idx) > 0 Then
                        lsx = WorldToScreenX(lx(l_idx), cam_x)
                        If Abs(esx - lsx) < 12 And Abs(ey(i) - ly(l_idx)) < 10 Then
                            llife(l_idx) = 0
                            SetHardwareSprite(SLOT_LASER0 + l_idx, 0, 0, 0, False, False)
                            KillEnemy(i)
                            score = score + 15
                            UpdateHUD()
                            hit = True
                            Exit For
                        End If
                    End If
                Next l_idx

                If Not hit Then
                    If Abs(esx - psx) < 10 And Abs(ey(i) - py) < 10 Then
                        KillEnemy(i)
                        LoseLife()
                        Exit For
                    End If

                    ' Enemy Shoots
                    If esx >= 12 And esx <= 244 And Rnd(35) = 0 Then
                        For s_idx = 0 To MAX_SHOTS - 1
                            If slife(s_idx) = 0 Then
                                sx(s_idx) = ex(i)
                                sy(s_idx) = ey(i)
                                If psx > esx Then svx(s_idx) = 5 Else svx(s_idx) = -5
                                If py > ey(i) Then svy(s_idx) = 2 Else svy(s_idx) = -2
                                slife(s_idx) = 24
                                Exit For
                            End If
                        Next s_idx
                    End If

                    If estate(i) = ST_MUTANT Then
                        epat = PAT_MUTANT
                        ecol = 10
                    Else
                        epat = PAT_LANDER
                        ecol = 12
                    End If

                    If esx >= -8 And esx <= 263 Then
                        SetHardwareSprite(SLOT_ENEMY0 + i, esx, ey(i), epat, False, True)
                    Else
                        SetHardwareSprite(SLOT_ENEMY0 + i, 0, 0, 0, False, False)
                    End If

                    erx = WorldToRadarX(ex(i))
                    ery = 154 + (ey(i) \ 7)
                    Plot erx, ery, ecol
                    old_erx(i) = erx
                    old_ery(i) = ery
                End If
            Else
                SetHardwareSprite(SLOT_ENEMY0 + i, 0, 0, 0, False, False)
            End If
        Next i

        ' --------------------------------------------------------------------
        ' 6. UPDATE ENEMY PROJECTILE HARDWARE SPRITES
        ' --------------------------------------------------------------------
        For i = 0 To MAX_SHOTS - 1
            If slife(i) > 0 Then
                sx(i) = (sx(i) + svx(i)) And WORLD_MASK
                sy(i) = sy(i) + svy(i)
                slife(i) = slife(i) - 1
                ssx = WorldToScreenX(sx(i), cam_x)
                If slife(i) > 0 And ssx >= 0 And ssx <= 255 And sy(i) > PLAY_TOP And sy(i) < PLAY_BOT Then
                    If Abs(ssx - psx) < 8 And Abs(sy(i) - py) < 8 Then
                        slife(i) = 0
                        SetHardwareSprite(SLOT_SHOT0 + i, 0, 0, 0, False, False)
                        LoseLife()
                        Exit For
                    End If
                    SetHardwareSprite(SLOT_SHOT0 + i, ssx, sy(i), PAT_BOLT, False, True)
                Else
                    slife(i) = 0
                    SetHardwareSprite(SLOT_SHOT0 + i, 0, 0, 0, False, False)
                End If
            Else
                SetHardwareSprite(SLOT_SHOT0 + i, 0, 0, 0, False, False)
            End If
        Next i

        ' --------------------------------------------------------------------
        ' 7. LAYER 2 TERRAIN STREAMING (8 SLICES ACROSS 256 PIXELS)
        ' --------------------------------------------------------------------
        ' NTC: the terrain scrolls with the copper (Layer 2's sideways scroll changed for the
        ' bottom of the screen only), and only the columns coming into view are drawn. The original
        ' redrew one 32-pixel slice a frame (it smeared); redrawing all of it each frame with
        ' Plot / Draw took 5 frames.
        Terrain cam_x

        ' --------------------------------------------------------------------
        ' 8. WAVE COMPLETION
        ' --------------------------------------------------------------------
        If enemies_alive <= 0 And enemies_to_spawn <= 0 Then
            wave = wave + 1
            score = score + humans_alive * 50
            If bombs < 5 Then bombs = bombs + 1
            Sound 1, 150, 15, 15
            Sound 2, 100, 15, 15
            InitWave()
        End If
    Loop

    ' Game Over Screen
    HideAllSprites()
    ClsAll
    Pen 10
    At 8, 9
    PrintS "G A M E   O V E R"
    Pen 15
    At 7, 12
    PrintS "FINAL SCORE: " & Str$(score)
    Pen 14
    At 7, 15
    PrintS "REACHED WAVE: " & Str$(wave)
    For i = 1 To 90
        Vsync
    Next i
Loop
' ============================================================================
' NTC: THE ORIGINAL'S CPC-STYLE STATEMENTS, ON THE NEXT
' ============================================================================

' the pens: Layer 2 colours (RRRGGGBB) for drawing; the words' palette rows
Sub SetPens()
    Dim k As Integer
    For k = 0 To 15
        penc(k) = Val(Mid$("000 003 224 028 031 226 252 255 146 002 224 031 028 226 252 255", k * 4 + 1, 3))
    Next k
    Board.Pal 2, "00FF00000000000000000000000025E3"
    Board.Pal 3, "00FC00000000000000000000000025E3"
    Board.Pal 4, "001F00000000000000000000000025E3"
    Board.Pal 5, "00E000000000000000000000000025E3"
    Board.Pal 6, "001C00000000000000000000000025E3"
    Board.Pal 7, "00E200000000000000000000000025E3"
End Sub

' Pen n: the colour for the words that follow
Sub Pen(ByVal n As Integer)
    Select Case n
        Case 14: txtPen = 3
        Case 11: txtPen = 4
        Case 10: txtPen = 5
        Case 12: txtPen = 6
        Case 13: txtPen = 7
        Case Else: txtPen = 2
    End Select
End Sub

Sub Paper(ByVal n As Integer)
End Sub

Sub Border(ByVal n As Integer)
    Nx.Border n And 7
End Sub

' At x, y: where the words go (1, 1 = the top left of the 32 x 24 picture)
Sub At(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
    atx = x + 3 : aty = y + 3
End Sub

Sub PrintS(ByVal t As String)
    Board.Text atx, aty, t, txtPen
    atx = atx + Len(t)
End Sub

Sub ClsAll()
    Dim k As Integer
    Board.Clear
    L2.Rect 0, 0, 256, 192, 0
    For k = 0 To 255
        ycol(k) = -1
    Next k
    terOn = 0
    Scroll.Show 0
End Sub

' Plot x, y, c: a point (y counts up from the bottom, as on the CPC), and the start of the next Draw
Sub Plot(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal c As Integer)
    gx = x : gy = y
    If x >= 0 And x < 256 And y >= 0 And y < 192 Then L2.Plot x, 191 - y, penc(c And 15)
End Sub

' Draw x, y, c: a line from the last point to x, y
Sub Draw(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal c As Integer)
    Dim dx As Integer, dy As Integer, sx1 As Integer, sy1 As Integer, e As Integer, e2 As Integer, x0 As Integer, y0 As Integer, col As Integer
    col = penc(c And 15)
    x0 = gx : y0 = gy
    dx = Abs(x - x0) : dy = -Abs(y - y0)
    If x0 < x Then sx1 = 1 Else sx1 = -1
    If y0 < y Then sy1 = 1 Else sy1 = -1
    e = dx + dy
    Do
        If x0 >= 0 And x0 < 256 And y0 >= 0 And y0 < 192 Then L2.Plot x0, 191 - y0, col
        If x0 = x And y0 = y Then Exit Do
        e2 = e * 2
        If e2 >= dy Then e = e + dy : x0 = x0 + sx1
        If e2 <= dx Then e = e + dx : y0 = y0 + sy1
    Loop
    gx = x : gy = y
End Sub

' Sound ch, pitch, length, volume: on the AY (channel 1 = A, 2 = B)
Sub Sound(ByVal ch As Integer, ByVal pitch As Integer, ByVal dur As Integer, ByVal vol As Integer)
    Sfx.Play (ch - 1) Mod 3, pitch, 0, vol, dur * 2 + 1, 0
End Sub

' Vsync: wait for the next frame (and keep the sound going)
Sub Vsync()
    Frame
    Scroll.Upload
    Sfx.Update
End Sub

' Key(n): the original's key numbers, on the Next's keyboard
Function Key(ByVal n As Integer) As Integer
    Select Case n
        Case 40: Key = Keys.Down(Keys.KeySpace)
        Case 3: Key = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyQ)
        Case 2: Key = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyA)
        Case 33: Key = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyO)
        Case 32: Key = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyP)
        Case 9: Key = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyZ)
        Case 36: Key = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyB)
        Case 34: Key = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyM)
        Case 38: Key = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyH)
        Case Else: Key = 0
    End Select
End Function

' Joy(0): the joystick as the original's bits (1 right, 2 left, 4 down, 8 up, 16 fire, 32 fire 2)
Function Joy(ByVal n As Integer) As Integer
    Dim j0 As Integer, r As Integer
    j0 = Keys.Joystick(n)
    r = 0
    If j0 And Keys.JoyRight Then r = r Or 1
    If j0 And Keys.JoyLeft Then r = r Or 2
    If j0 And Keys.JoyDown Then r = r Or 4
    If j0 And Keys.JoyUp Then r = r Or 8
    If j0 And Keys.JoyFire1 Then r = r Or 16
    If j0 And Keys.JoyFire2 Then r = r Or 32
    Joy = r
End Function

' NTC: the terrain. Layer 2's column (wx And 255) holds world x wx; the copper scrolls the bottom
' of the screen (from line 160) by cx And 255, so the screen shows world x cx .. cx + 255 there.
' Only the columns that come into view since last time are drawn.
Sub Terrain(ByVal cx As Integer)
    Dim d As Integer, wx As Integer, k As Integer
    If terOn = 0 Or terDead <> planet_dead Then
        For k = 0 To 255
            Col (cx + k) And WORLD_MASK
        Next k
    Else
        d = (cx - tcam) And WORLD_MASK
        If d >= 512 Then d = d - 1024
        If d >= 256 Or d <= -256 Then
            For k = 0 To 255
                Col (cx + k) And WORLD_MASK
            Next k
        ElseIf d > 0 Then
            For k = 256 - d To 255
                Col (cx + k) And WORLD_MASK
            Next k
        ElseIf d < 0 Then
            For k = 0 To -d - 1
                Col (cx + k) And WORLD_MASK
            Next k
        End If
    End If
    terOn = 1 : terDead = planet_dead : tcam = cx
    Scroll.Show cx And 255
End Sub

' one column of the terrain: the old pixel off, the new on (in between the 4-pixel steps of
' GetTerrainY, so it's a slope, not stairs)
Sub Col(ByVal wx As Integer)
    Dim c As Integer, h0 As Integer, h1 As Integer, y As Integer
    c = wx And 255
    If ycol(c) >= 0 Then L2.Plot c, ycol(c), 0
    h0 = GetTerrainY(wx) : h1 = GetTerrainY((wx + 4) And WORLD_MASK)
    y = 191 - (h0 + (h1 - h0) * (wx And 3) \ 4)
    L2.Plot c, y, penc(12)
    ycol(c) = y
End Sub

files.text:
' Nx - the ZX Spectrum Next's own hardware, straight on the ports: NextRegs (#243B select,
' #253B value), the layer order, the border, palettes, the CPU speed.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' No Z80N opcodes are used (plain out (c)), so any Z80 assembler builds it.
Option Explicit

' layer orders (NextReg #15 bits 4-2): first = on top. S sprites, L Layer 2, U ULA + tilemap
Public Const OrderSLU = 0
Public Const OrderLSU = 1
Public Const OrderSUL = 2
Public Const OrderLUS = 3
Public Const OrderUSL = 4
Public Const OrderULS = 5
' palettes for PalEntry / PalTable (NextReg #43 bits 6-4, the first of each pair)
Public Const PalULA = 0
Public Const PalLayer2 = 1
Public Const PalSprites = 2
Public Const PalTiles = 3

' Reg r, v: NextReg r = v
Public Sub Reg(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
#endasm
End Sub

' RegGet(r): NextReg r read back
Public Function RegGet(ByVal r As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Layers order: which layer is on top (OrderSLU ...), sprites on and over the border kept
Public Sub Layers(ByVal order As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #15
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            and %11100011
            or e
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Border c: the border colour (0-7, port #FE)
Public Sub Border(ByVal c As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            out (#FE), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalEntry which, index, colour: one colour (RRRGGGBB) of a palette (PalULA ... PalTiles, the
' first palette of each)
Public Sub PalEntry(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal index As Integer, ByVal colour As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a                 ; palette select, bits 6-4
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; index
            pop hl
            ld l, (hl)              ; colour
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), l
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalTable which, first, count, address: count colours (1 byte each, RRRGGGBB) from memory
Public Sub PalTable(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer, ByVal address As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; count (1-256: 0 = 256)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
pt_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            dec e
            jr nz, pt_lp
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Raster(): the line the display is on now (0-311; 0-191 the picture)
Public Function Raster() As Integer
#asm
            ld bc, #243B
rs_again:
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in d, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1F
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            dec b
            cp d
            jr nz, rs_again
            and 1
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

' Seed n: start Rnd's sequence from n (as Randomize n - kept here because Randomize with a
' variable doesn't link on its own in this NTC build: kw_seedv jumps into kw_seedl's section)
Public Sub Seed(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            or h
            jr nz, sd_ok
            inc l
sd_ok:
            ld (ntc_rnd_seed), hl
#endasm
End Sub

files.name: Spr.cls
files.text:
' Spr - the Next's 128 hardware sprites, straight on the ports (#303B slot, #57 attributes).
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' 4 bit patterns (GfxData.Load puts them in the sprite RAM), 16 x 16 pixels, scaled 1x - 8x.
' Put / Hide write a table in RAM; Show sends the table to the hardware in one go (do it just
' after Frame, so nothing moves half way down the screen).
' Coordinates are the tilemap's: 0, 0 is the top left of the whole 320 x 256 picture (the
' border included); the 256 x 192 paper is 32 - 287 across, 32 - 223 down. A sprite at x -16 .. or
' y -16 .. wraps (512): keep it hidden instead.
Option Explicit

' flags for Put: add them
Public Const MirrorX = 8
Public Const MirrorY = 4
Public Const Rotate = 2
Public Const Scale2X = &H800
Public Const Scale2Y = &H200
Public Const Scale2 = &HA00
Public Const Scale4X = &H1000
Public Const Scale4Y = &H400
Public Const Scale4 = &H1400
' a palette offset: Pal * n (n 0 - 15: spr_pal.png's row n)
Public Const Pal = 16

Private tab(639) As Byte          ' 128 x 5 attribute bytes
Private used As Integer           ' the highest slot Put + 1 (Show sends that many)

' Init: every sprite hidden, sprites on (over the border too), transparent colour 15
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 639
    tab(i) = 0
  Next
  For i = 3 To 639 Step 5
    tab(i) = &H40                ' hidden, but still 5 bytes (the upload stays in step)
  Next
  used = 128
  Show
  used = 0
  Nx.Reg &H4B, &HF               ' 4 bit sprites: colour 15 is transparent
  Nx.Reg &H15, (Nx.RegGet(&H15) And &H1C) Or 3   ' sprites on, over the border; the order kept
End Sub

' Put n, x, y, pattern, flags: sprite n (0-127) at x, y showing pattern (0-127), with flags
' (MirrorX + Scale2 + Pal * 2 ...)
Public Sub Put(ByVal n As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal pattern As Integer, ByVal flags As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld c, a
            inc a
            ld hl, {used}
            cp (hl)
            jr c, sp_low
            ld (hl), a
sp_low:
            ld l, c                 ; DE = tab + n * 5
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab}
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl                  ; x
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 0: x bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld c, a                 ; x bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; y
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 1: y bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld b, a                 ; y bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; pattern
            ld a, (hl)
            ex af, af'
            pop hl                  ; flags
            ld a, (hl)
            and #FE
            or c
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 2: palette offset, mirrors, rotate, x bit 8
            inc de
            inc hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; scale bits
            ex af, af'
            ld l, a
            srl a
            or #C0
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 3: visible, 5 bytes, pattern bits 6-1
            inc de
            ld a, l
            and 1
            rrca
            rrca
            or #80
            or b
            ld b, a
            ld a, c
            and #1E
            or b
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 4: 4 bit, pattern bit 0, scale, y bit 8
#endasm
End Sub

' Hide n: sprite n not shown
Public Sub Hide(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), #40            ; not visible, 5 bytes kept (else the upload slips a byte)
#endasm
End Sub

' HideRange first, count: those sprites not shown
Public Sub HideRange(ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, hr_done
            ld b, a
            ex de, hl
            ld de, 5
hr_lp:
            ld (hl), #40
            add hl, de
            djnz hr_lp
hr_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Show: the table to the hardware (the slots up to the highest one Put)
Public Sub Show()
#asm
            ld a, ({used})
            or a
            jr z, sh_done
            ld bc, #303B
            xor a
            out (c), a
            ld a, ({used})
            ld e, a                 ; E sprites, 5 bytes each
            ld hl, {tab}
            ld c, #57
sh_lp:
            ld b, 5
            otir
            dec e
            jr nz, sh_lp
sh_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Visible(n): True when sprite n is shown
Public Function Visible(ByVal n As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            ld de, 0
            and #80
            jr z, vi_no
            dec de
vi_no:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

files.name: Tiles.cls
files.text:
' Tiles - the Next's tilemap as a 4 bit picture: 40 x 32 cells of 8 x 8 pixels over the whole
' 320 x 256 display (the border included), 16 colours (tile_pal.png), colour 15 transparent.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' The map stays where the platform put it (bank 5 + #2000, seen at #E000: one byte a cell, the
' tile number), so Print and Locate still work on it: the font is tiles 32-126 (a character's code
' is its tile). The tile definitions go to bank 5 + #0000 (#C000-#DFFF, 32 bytes a tile): the
' ULA screen's place, so the ULA is turned off. Don't use Mode or Cls after Init (Mode puts the
' platform's own text tiles back; Cls is all right but fills with tile 32).
' Print near the right edge or the last row wraps and scrolls: end prints with ; and keep them
' off row 32 and column 40.
Option Explicit

Public Const Cols = 40
Public Const Rows = 32
Private Const MAPA = &HE000

' Init: the tilemap on, 40 x 32, 4 bit tiles from #C000, no attribute bytes, over the ULA;
' the ULA off; no scroll; the whole picture
Public Sub Init()
  Nx.Reg &H68, Nx.RegGet(&H68) Or &H80     ' the ULA off (its screen's RAM holds the tiles)
  Nx.Reg &H6E, &H20                         ' the map: bank 5 + #2000
  Nx.Reg &H6F, &H0                          ' the tile definitions: bank 5 + #0000
  Nx.Reg &H6C, 0                            ' every cell: palette offset 0, no mirror
  Nx.Reg &H4C, &HF                          ' colour 15 transparent
  Nx.Reg &H2F, 0 : Nx.Reg &H30, 0 : Nx.Reg &H31, 0
  Nx.Reg &H1C, 8                            ' the clip window: all of it
  Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 159 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 255
  Nx.Reg &H6B, &HA1                         ' on, 40 x 32, no attributes, 4 bit, over the ULA
End Sub

' Put x, y, t: cell x (0-39), y (0-31) shows tile t
Public Sub Put(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; x
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)              ; y
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de              ; y * 40
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Get(x, y): the tile in cell x, y
Public Function Get(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ld e, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' At(px, py): the tile under pixel px, py (0-319, 0-255), 0 off the map
Public Function At(ByVal px As Integer, ByVal py As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)              ; px
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)              ; py
            ld a, b
            or a
            jr nz, at_off
            ld a, d
            cp 2
            jr nc, at_off
            ld hl, -320
            add hl, de
            jr c, at_off
            srl d                   ; px / 8
            rr e
            srl e
            srl e
            ld a, c
            and #F8                 ; (py / 8) * 8
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, bc              ; (py / 8) * 40
            ld d, #E0
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            jr at_set
at_off:
            ld e, 0
at_set:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Fill t: every cell tile t
Public Sub Fill(ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld hl, #E000
            ld de, #E001
            ld bc, 40 * 32 - 1
            ld (hl), a
            ldir
#endasm
End Sub

' Rect x, y, w, h, t: a block of cells
Public Sub Rect(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal w As Integer, ByVal h As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
  Dim i As Integer, j As Integer
  For j = y To y + h - 1
    For i = x To x + w - 1
      Put i, j, t
    Next
  Next
End Sub

' Text x, y, s: text from cell x, y (the font tiles), no wrap, no scroll
Public Sub Text(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal s As String)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
tx_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, tx_done
            ld (de), a
            inc hl
            inc de
            ld a, d
            cp #E5                  ; past the map's end (#E500)
            jr nc, tx_done
            jr tx_lp
tx_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Scroll x, y: the tilemap moved by x (0-319) and y (0-255) pixels
Public Sub Scroll(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
  Nx.Reg &H2F, (x \ 256) And 3
  Nx.Reg &H30, x And 255
  Nx.Reg &H31, y And 255
End Sub

files.name: Sfx.cls
files.text:
' Sfx - sound effects on the Next's AY chip (the first of its three), straight on the ports:
' #FFFD picks a register, #BFFD writes it. Three channels, each playing one effect at a time:
' a tone or noise whose pitch slides and whose volume fades to nothing over its length.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' Call Update once a frame (50 a second).
'   Sfx.Play 0, 200, 8, 15, 12, 0     ' channel A: tone period 200, rising pitch... 12 frames
Option Explicit

Private per(2) As Integer         ' the tone period now (12 bits; noise: 0-31)
Private slide(2) As Integer       ' added to it each frame
Private vol(2) As Integer         ' the volume it starts at (0-15)
Private total(2) As Integer       ' its length in frames
Private left(2) As Integer        ' frames to go (0 = silent)
Private nse(2) As Integer         ' 1 = noise, 0 = tone
Private mix As Integer

Private Sub W(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #FFFD
            out (c), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld b, #BF
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Init: AY 1 picked (the Next has three: Turbosound), every channel quiet
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  Out &HFFFD, &HFF                 ' AY 1 (Turbosound: #FF, #FE, #FD pick the chips)
  For i = 0 To 13
    W i, 0
  Next
  W 7, &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
  Next
End Sub

' Play ch, period, slidePerFrame, volume, frames, noise: start an effect on channel ch (0-2)
Public Sub Play(ByVal ch As Integer, ByVal period As Integer, ByVal sl As Integer, ByVal volume As Integer, ByVal frames As Integer, ByVal noise As Integer)
  If ch < 0 Or ch > 2 Then Exit Sub
  per(ch) = period : slide(ch) = sl : vol(ch) = volume : total(ch) = frames : left(ch) = frames : nse(ch) = noise
End Sub

' Busy(ch): True while channel ch plays
Public Function Busy(ByVal ch As Integer) As Integer
  Busy = (left(ch) > 0)
End Function

' Update: once a frame - the pitches slide, the volumes fade, the AY written
Public Sub Update()
  Dim i As Integer, v As Integer, p As Integer
  mix = &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    If left(i) > 0 Then
      v = (vol(i) * left(i) + total(i) - 1) \ total(i)
      p = per(i)
      If nse(i) Then
        W 6, p And 31
        mix = mix And Not (8 * (2 ^ i))
      Else
        W i * 2, p And 255
        W i * 2 + 1, (p \ 256) And 15
        mix = mix And Not (2 ^ i)
      End If
      W 8 + i, v
      per(i) = per(i) + slide(i)
      If per(i) < 1 Then per(i) = 1
      left(i) = left(i) - 1
    Else
      W 8 + i, 0
    End If
  Next
  W 7, mix
End Sub

' Quiet: every channel stopped
Public Sub Quiet()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
    W 8 + i, 0
  Next
End Sub

files.name: Board.cls
files.text:
' Board - the card table on the Next's tilemap: 40 x 32 cells, 2 bytes each (the tile, its palette
' row), so each card can be in its own colours. The tiles (GfxData) at bank 5 + #0000, the map at
' bank 5 + #2000 (#E000).
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
Option Explicit

Private tc As Integer

' Init: the tilemap with attributes (after Tiles.Init and GfxData.Load)
Public Sub Init()
  Nx.Reg &H6B, &H81                        ' the tilemap: on, 40 x 32, 2 bytes a cell, 4 bit
  Clear
End Sub

' Clear: every cell tile 0 (see-through)
Public Sub Clear()
#asm
            ld hl, #E000
            ld de, #E001
            ld bc, 2559
            ld (hl), 0
            ldir
#endasm
End Sub

' Put x, y, t, p: cell x, y shows tile t in palette row p
Public Sub Put(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal t As Integer, ByVal p As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a                 ; DE = #E000 + (y * 40 + x) * 2
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, 0
            add hl, bc
            add hl, hl
            ld de, #E000
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            and #F0
            ld (de), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Text x, y, s, p: a string from cell x, y in palette row p (the font is the tiles 32-95)
Public Sub Text(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal s As String, ByVal p As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, 0
            add hl, bc
            add hl, hl
            ld de, #E000
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld ({tc}), hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            and #F0
            ld c, a
            ld hl, ({tc})
st_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, st_done
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld a, c
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            inc hl
            ld a, d
            cp #EA
            jr nc, st_done
            jr st_lp
st_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Rect x, y, w, h, t, p: a block of one tile
Public Sub Rect(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal w As Integer, ByVal h As Integer, ByVal t As Integer, ByVal p As Integer)
  Dim i As Integer, j As Integer
  For j = y To y + h - 1
    For i = x To x + w - 1
      Put i, j, t, p
    Next
  Next
End Sub

' Pal row, s: the tilemap's palette row (0-15) from s, 16 colours as hex pairs (RRRGGGBB)
Public Sub Pal(ByVal row As Integer, ByVal s As String)
  Dim k As Integer
  For k = 0 To 15
    Nx.PalEntry Nx.PalTiles, row * 16 + k, Hx(s, k)
  Next
End Sub

' Hx(s, k): the k-th hex pair in s
Private Function Hx(ByVal s As String, ByVal k As Integer) As Integer
  Dim a As Integer, b As Integer
  a = Asc(Mid$(s, k * 2 + 1, 1)) : b = Asc(Mid$(s, k * 2 + 2, 1))
  If a > 57 Then a = a - 55 Else a = a - 48
  If b > 57 Then b = b - 55 Else b = b - 48
  Hx = a * 16 + b
End Function

files.name: L2.cls
files.text:
' L2 - Layer 2 for the backdrops: 256 x 192, one byte a pixel (RRRGGGBB colours), bank 16 (pages
' 32-37, each 32 lines, put in at #C000 through MMU slot 6 while drawing, then bank 5's page 10
' back). Behind the tilemap and the sprites.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
Option Explicit

Private sc As Integer, sw As Integer, fa As Integer, pb As Integer, vis As Integer

' Init: Layer 2 on, 256 x 192, no scroll, the whole of it
Public Sub Init()
  Nx.Reg &H70, 0
  Nx.Reg &H12, 16
  Nx.Reg &H1C, 1
  Nx.Reg &H18, 0 : Nx.Reg &H18, 255 : Nx.Reg &H18, 0 : Nx.Reg &H18, 191
  Nx.Reg &H16, 0 : Nx.Reg &H17, 0
  Out &H123B, 2
  ' two screens: bank 16 and bank 19. Both cleared; bank 16 is shown and drawn on
  vis = 19 : pb = 38
  Rect 0, 0, 256, 192, 0
  vis = 16 : pb = 32
  Rect 0, 0, 256, 192, 0
End Sub

' Back: draw on the screen that isn't shown (until Flip)
Public Sub Back()
  If vis = 16 Then pb = 38 Else pb = 32
End Sub

' Flip: show the screen just drawn on (and keep drawing on it)
Public Sub Flip()
  vis = pb \ 2
  Nx.Reg &H12, vis
End Sub

' Span x, y, w, c: w pixels (1-256, not past the right edge) of colour c from x, y
Public Sub Span(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal w As Integer, ByVal c As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; x
            pop hl
            ld d, (hl)              ; y
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)              ; w
            ld ({sw}), bc
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld ({sc}), a            ; colour
            ld a, d
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            and 7
            ld h, a
            ld a, ({pb})
            add a, h
            ld h, a                 ; the page: pb + y / 32
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, h
            out (c), a
            ld a, d
            and 31
            or #C0
            ld h, a
            ld l, e                 ; HL = #C000 + (y And 31) * 256 + x
            ld bc, ({sw})
            ld a, b
            or c
            jr z, l2_back
            ld a, ({sc})
            ld (hl), a
            dec bc
            ld a, b
            or c
            jr z, l2_back
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            inc de
            ldir
l2_back:
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, 10
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Rect x, y, w, h, c: a block
Public Sub Rect(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal w As Integer, ByVal h As Integer, ByVal c As Integer)
  Dim j As Integer
  For j = y To y + h - 1
    Span x, j, w, c
  Next
End Sub

' Plot x, y, c: one pixel
Public Sub Plot(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal c As Integer)
  If x >= 0 And x < 256 And y >= 0 And y < 192 Then Span x, y, 1, c
End Sub

' Big x, y, s, z, c1, c2: text s drawn z times the size, colour c1 on top shading to c2, with a
' dark shadow (colour 0) two pixels down and right. The letters are read from the tilemap's font
' (tiles 32-95 at #C000, 4 bits a pixel: colour 1 is the letter)
Public Sub Big(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal s As String, ByVal z As Integer, ByVal c1 As Integer, ByVal c2 As Integer)
  Dim k As Integer, r As Integer, b As Integer, i As Integer, run As Integer, a As Integer, col As Integer, pass As Integer, sh As Integer, m As Integer, v As Integer
  For pass = 0 To 1
    sh = (1 - pass) * 2
    For k = 1 To Len(s)
      a = &HC000 + Asc(Mid$(s, k, 1)) * 32
      For r = 0 To 7
        b = 0 : m = 128
        For i = 0 To 3
          v = Peek(a + r * 4 + i)
          If (v \ 16) = 1 Then b = b Or m
          If (v And 15) = 1 Then b = b Or (m \ 2)
          m = m \ 4
        Next
        col = 0
        If pass Then
          col = c2
          If r < 4 Then col = c1
        End If
        i = 0
        Do While b
          If b And 128 Then
            run = 0
            Do While b And 128
              run = run + 1 : b = (b * 2) And 255
            Loop
            Rect x + ((k - 1) * 8 + i) * z + sh, y + r * z + sh, run * z, z, col
            i = i + run
          Else
            i = i + 1 : b = (b * 2) And 255
          End If
        Loop
      Next
    Next
  Next
End Sub

files.name: Scroll.cls
files.text:
' Scroll - NTC build: the copper scrolls Layer 2 sideways from line 160 down (the terrain) and
' not above it (the scanner). Show sets the scroll for the next frame; Upload (straight after
' Frame) hands the list to the copper.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
Option Explicit

Private cop(15) As Byte

Public Sub Show(ByVal sx As Integer)
  cop(0) = &H80 : cop(1) = 0                ' line 0:
  cop(2) = &H16 : cop(3) = 0                '   no scroll
  cop(4) = &H80 : cop(5) = 160              ' line 160:
  cop(6) = &H16 : cop(7) = sx And 255       '   the terrain's scroll
  cop(8) = &HFF : cop(9) = &HFF             ' the end
End Sub

Public Sub Upload()
#asm
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #61
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
            dec b
            ld a, #62
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a              ; stopped, index 0
            dec b
            ld a, #60
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld hl, {cop}
            ld e, 10
sc_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            dec e
            jr nz, sc_lp
            dec b
            ld a, #62
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, #C0
            out (c), a              ; start: from 0, again at each frame
#endasm
End Sub
